Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL3227967. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3227967'. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
